name: El Nino forecast (ENSO models)
description: Nino 3.4 from OISST with the WOD thermocline (warm-water volume) and ERA5 wind stress: the ENSO library's baselines, recharge and delayed oscillators, linear inverse model and a gradient-boosting forecaster (quick settings), tuned on 1982-2011 and scored on the untouched test period from 2012 against climatology and persistence. The intermediate coupled model (im_nudged) is left out of this example: it ran for more than 55 minutes without finishing on a 4-core CPU.
